top_signals.title: Gold Declines as Bond Yields Stay Elevated Despite Oil Drop
top_signals.summary: Gold slipped as bond yields stayed elevated despite falling energy prices, with traders assessing the outlook for the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: France hit by worst unrest in years as attempts to rein in government spending meet citizen ire
top_signals.summary: France’s worst unrest in years saw thousands arrested, prompting President Macron to vow an “uncompromising” response ahead of a critical budget vote.
